preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(a) <= 100000 for a in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string a in the test cases must have a length between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ANTO' for c in a) for a in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string a must be one of 'A', 'N', 'O', or 'T'.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(any(b.count(c) == a.count(c) for c in 'ANTO') for a, b in zip(test_cases, stdout))
postconditions.description: Each output string b must be a permutation of the corresponding input string a.

postconditions.expression: all(any(b[i] != b[i+1] for i in range(len(b)-1)) for b in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output string b must have at least one pair of adjacent characters that are different.
